paired_bootstrap.reason: Fewer than five independent signer/session groups are in the test split; sample-level resampling would overstate independent evidence.
paired_bootstrap.method: Group bootstrap not run because the test split has too few groups.

selection_guidance.candidate_rule: Both paired-bootstrap 95% intervals for accuracy and macro-F1 deltas must be wholly above zero, no priority class may show a 95% interval wholly below zero, and the shared test rows must have no exact feature matches in the configured legacy training input.
selection_guidance.recommendation: V2 has not demonstrated the required improvement; the protected baseline remains the active model.

historical_baseline_reference.note: Compared models above are evaluated on the same V2 held-out test rows. The existing stored random-holdout metrics differ and are not substituted for the historical reference.
